placements.why: The envelope's content is E2E testing that reproduces a production failure and prescribes behavioral constraints — verification/proof work that names an organizational category nothing in the empty strata or graph covers.
placements.title: From production failure to verified reproduction
placements.frame: what must a test reproduce and guarantee to count as valid evidence?

placements.title: Reproduction must prove the fix holds
placements.frame: what must a test both reproduce and guarantee to validly close a production failure?
placements.why: Both segments cohere around a single theme: src-1 identifies the production failure pattern being reproduced (a ## heading with no id field), and src-2 prescribes the non-negotiable constraints (no crash, valid slug) that make the reproduction valid. This is a thematic container future test-case envelopes will keep feeding — the question of what a reproduction must hold and must deliver — not a one-time fact.
